title: done credits a goal research commit as an item's work only for a file of the item's own, not a shared ledger every research commit edits
goal: bl_land.research_carried counts a research commit for an item only when it changed a file of the item's touches other than a root's shared ledgers (_answers.md, _sources.csv, _anchors.csv, _gaps.md, _conflicts.md, _retrieval/ files), so a sibling touching kb/public/_sources.csv is not done through a research commit that added a source row (SP-ce5iig4g review: _tools/bl_land.py:90 takes any touched file but the always-in-scope ones)

run:
import sys, types
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_land as L
L.research_story = lambda bl, sid: "ST-resrch0"
files = dict()
L.item_commits = lambda root, ids: files
bl = types.SimpleNamespace(items=dict(), root=".", sprint_of=lambda i: "SP-sprint00", ancestors=lambda i: [], descendants=lambda i: [])
bl.items["ST-sibling0"] = dict()
ledgers = ["_answers.md", "_sources.csv", "_anchors.csv", "_gaps.md", "_conflicts.md", "_retrieval/x/rows.csv"]
leaked = []
for name in ledgers:
    path = "kb/public/" + name
    files.clear()
    files["sha1"] = [path]
    if L.research_carried(bl, "ST-sibling0", [path]) is not None:
        leaked.append(name)
files.clear()
files["sha2"] = ["kb/public/topic.md"]
control = L.research_carried(bl, "ST-sibling0", ["kb/public/topic.md"]) is not None
print("credited by a shared ledger:", leaked, "control", control, file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(0 if not leaked and control else 1)
